method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: The north panorama stands about 4.3 m from the front and was resected on the joint with the pass 69 corner house and on its base row (camera 2.3 m). The south panorama was fitted to the glass tower's edges from the north view and to its own base row; the fit leaves up to 20 px on the tower edges (the tower may stand slightly back) but puts the south end of the house within 0.12 m of the district outline. Heights are taken from the closer north view. The roof pitch and the dormers' depth are estimates.
